title: Argentinian Empanadas with Umami Crust
description: A crispy empanada recipe with a savory umami twist, inspired by Argentinian flavors. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: Crispy
ingredients.notes: crushed tortilla chips or crispy fried onions

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine flour, umami, and crispy. Mix well.
3. Gradually add water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
4. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
5. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
6. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
7. Place a tablespoon of argentinian filling in the center of each circle.
8. Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press edges to seal.
9. Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
10. Bake for 20-22 minutes, or until golden brown.
